batch_notes: The hooks are the strongest set yet: 9 of 12 carry her cost with a body or time detail, and the public/family scenes (checkout, ملكة, جمعة, restaurant) finally test the legacy lane. The weakest format is F7: the two F7 benefits posts (nails, restaurant) have no second-person story inside each point, so they read as F5/F6 and the F7 test won't be readable, and the ride post (F7 mistakes) is the one lukewarm post. Every final CTA (12 of 12) uses the same 'notice what happened before' + 'these details help you build a plan that suits him' shape; it's accurate and on-brief, but by the third post on the same evening she'll skim it. Repeated across posts: 'step out for a bit and come back' (ملكة and جمعة), biscuits (two posts), «معلومة، مو شكوى» (two), 'changes with him / حسب استجابته' (three), and «خليه هو اللي» as the core move in five. All 12 pass the gate; the only flag before building is the hand-dryer slide 1 «اذاني طفل», which needs Anhar to confirm it's intended.
